title.narrative: Influence: Normalizing Human Rights and Democracy through Popular Culture

description.narrative:
Impact: To improve public perceptions of human rights (HR) and democracy (D) in Israel and normalize rights-based public discourse.

Outcomes:

1)     To cultivate and train a network of public influencers to mediate positive messages around HR and D to broad-based followings

2)     To increase the Israeli public's exposure to HR and D messages via mainstream media, social media and the dissemination of cultural products

To engage targeted communities from across the social spectrum via a positive, relatable and relevant discourse of HR and democracy
